label: CJEU C-453/21 — X-FAB Dresden (DPO conflict of interest) — EU-authoritative; persuasive only in the UK
body: 2. A "conflict of interests" under Art. 38(6) may exist where a DPO is entrusted with other tasks that would result in them determining the objectives and methods of processing on the part of the controller/processor. Determined case by case by national courts, taking the organisational structure and applicable rules into account.

Why it matters: A DPO who also holds roles that set processing purposes/means is structurally at risk of conflict — assessed case by case, not per se. Enforcement signal: the Belgian DPA fined a company €50,000 (28 April 2020) where the DPO was dual-hatted as head of compliance, audit and risk; the EDPB ran a coordinated enforcement framework action on DPOs in 2023 (report January 2024). UK note: X-FAB post-dates the Brexit transition period, so it is persuasive but not binding in the UK.
